ModMetaData.name: KarmaHSK
ModMetaData.author: linyaDev
ModMetaData.description:
[English] Adds a mood penalty when quest acceptance time expires. Each expired quest gives -3 mood debuff for 2 years. Stacks up to 7 times (max -21).
[Russian] Adds a mood penalty when quest acceptance time expires. Each expired quest gives -3 mood debuff for 2 years. Stacks up to 7 times (max -21).
